chunks.title: Company Overview
chunks.content: xPlumbers Plumbing and Water Cleanup is the #1 plumbing and drain cleaning company. Founded in 1935 by Samuel Blanc who invented the world's first electromechanical sewer and drain cleaning machine in 1933. The company has been trusted and recommended since 1935. xPlumber is the oldest and most experienced brand among sewer line repair companies. They are a full-service plumbing, drain, and water restoration company. The company operates through independently owned and operated franchise locations across the United States and Canada.

chunks.title: Brand Promise and Differentiators
chunks.content: The xPlumbers Difference: Reputation - Highly-trained professionals since 1935, a job done right by the original experts. Transparency - Free onsite estimates, no hidden or extra charges for plumbing or drain service on holidays, nights, and weekends. Efficiency - Same-day and emergency service 365 days a year. Quality - Full-service plumbing, drain cleaning, and water cleanup using state-of-the-art diagnostics and equipment. Financing - Get it fixed today and take time to pay, special financing options available. Technicians are uniformed and badged, arrive in clearly marked and branded vehicles, fully licensed and insured. Upfront, honest pricing with transparent quotes and no hidden fees.

chunks.title: Service Coverage
chunks.content: xPlumber provides services across the United States and Canada. The website is intended for use in the United States and Canada. Service offerings, hours of operations, pricing structure, and guarantees may vary by location. Local offices are independently owned and operated franchises. Each location serves specific metro areas and surrounding communities. 24/7 emergency service available nationwide.

chunks.title: Certifications and Standards
chunks.content: xPLumbers water damage restoration technicians are IICRC-certified (Institute of Inspection, Cleaning, and Restoration Certification). All water damage cleanup processes follow IICRC guidelines for cleanup, drying, decontamination, and restoration. Plumbers are fully licensed and insured. Technicians complete rigorous training and testing. The company follows ANSI IIRC standards for water damage restoration. xPLumbers has an A+ BBB rating.
